brushstroke: Clean, flat color application characteristic of woodblock printing rather than visible brushwork.

brushstroke: Fine, controlled ink brushstrokes define the landscape features, while fluid, rhythmic strokes characterize the elegant calligraphy.

brushstroke: Delicate and varied ink washes combined with dry-brush textures to define the rugged surfaces of the rocks and the foliage of the trees.
